jobs.description:
Do you like to finish work early so that you can still do something with the rest of your day? Then get started as a logistics employee for UPS, United Parcel Service, in Eindhoven! You will work short shifts during the week from 4:00 to 8:00 and earn €15.85 gross per hour! Do you like to get things done, do you want to have time during the week and enjoy your weekend? Then read on and apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for several logistics employees for UPS in Eindhoven, for the morning shift.

Together with your colleagues, you will work hard to achieve targets. You will ensure that all packages are processed on time! This way you ensure that all orders are delivered on time. What will you do:

    - Processing incoming goods and packages
    
- Sorting shipments by postcode
    
- Loading and unloading trucks
    
- Scanning and checking packages and documents
    
- Lifting and moving orders (muscles are required, because the packages can weigh up to 23 kilos!)

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.85 per hour
    
- Additional ADV allowance of 1.38% on top of your salary!
    
- Travel allowance according to the UPS scheme
    
- Part-time job of 20 hours per week
    
- Function for a longer period with pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Opportunities for growth
    
- Free access to the e-learning platform Manpower Academy

    - Good command of the Dutch or English language in connection with safety on the work floor and following work instructions
    
- Able and willing to apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
    
- Physically able to perform long-term heavy(er) work (bending, lifting up to 23 kilograms, walking and standing a lot)
    
- Own transport to get to the work location (for example a bicycle, car or scooter)
    
- In addition, you preferably live in (the vicinity of) Eindhoven, Best, Waalre

Do you want to get started for UPS? Then don't wait until the vacancy closes and apply now! Manpower will contact you within two working days!
